description: This Java source file contains integration tests for verifying CORS (Cross-Origin Resource Sharing) compliance of an HTTP adapter in the Eclipse Hono project. The tests focus on handling CORS preflight OPTIONS requests for various endpoints related to telemetry, events, and commands, ensuring the adapter returns correct HTTP headers in responses.
